existing.description: The QUT International Merit Scholarship is a high-achievement scholarship for future international undergraduate and postgraduate students. According to QUT's own international student scholarships hub, it covers 25% of tuition fees for the full duration of the program provided the recipient meets the minimum academic standards of the course, and it is available in selected faculties only. It sits alongside two separate QUT awards with different values and eligibility rules: the International Talent Scholarship (20% of tuition fees per semester, selected faculties and countries only) and the QUT College Merit Scholarship (25% of the first semester tuition fee for a foundation or diploma program, selected countries only).
eligibility: Enrol in an undergraduate or postgraduate degree course in a selected faculty
Meet the minimum academic standards of the course to keep the scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: Available to future international undergraduate and postgraduate students in selected faculties who meet the minimum academic standards of their course. QUT's international scholarship hub confirms the faculty restriction but the full eligibility criteria sit on the scholarship's dedicated page, which could not be read on the verification date.
benefits: 25% of tuition fees for the full duration of the program
Continued support only while minimum academic standards are met
coverage: 25% of tuition fees for the full duration of the program
requirements: Meet the minimum academic standards of the course to retain the scholarship for the full duration
application_method: Check eligibility on the QUT scholarship page
Apply for a degree course at QUT in a participating faculty
existing.selection_notes: QUT describes it as a high achievement scholarship, so selection is based on prior academic achievement. Recipients must keep meeting the minimum academic standards of the course to retain the ongoing reduction.
existing.application_period: QUT's international scholarship hub invites applications and states that the on-time application closing date for the upcoming semester is approaching, but no date for this scholarship is published on the pages that could be read. The scholarship's dedicated page could not be retrieved because its response exceeded the fetch size limit.
